scope: TRAIN/VALIDATION-only observed flight representation studies; no new-source head results

training_recipe.family_class_weights: inverse sqrt train count, normalized over supported labels
training_recipe.side_class_weights: inverse sqrt train count, normalized over supported labels
training_recipe.normalization: train available rows mean/std, std floor0.05, normalized clipping[-10,10]
training_recipe.selection: maximum average validation strict family macroF1-supported and side balanced recall; ties prefer family/side tuple then earlier epoch

thresholds.insufficient_evidence: disable class by threshold1.01; never force a label

training_recipe.future_test_policy: New independent source holdout required; R2 match3 results are known, no R3 test predictions opened
training_recipe.conditional_on: Published weak source contact clock and source hitter-foot association, NOT automatic hit/hitter detection
